#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

void process(const string& s, int idx, string& ans, bool& good) {
    if (idx == (int)s.length()) return;
    if (s[idx] == 't' && idx != (int)s.length() - 1) {
        if (ans.length() >= 2 && ans.back() == 'a' && !good) {
            ans.pop_back();
            ans.push_back('@');
            good = true;
        } else if (ans.length() >= 3 && ans[ans.length()-2] == 'd' && ans.back() == 'o') {
            ans.pop_back();
            ans.pop_back();
            ans.push_back('.');
        } else {
            ans.push_back(s[idx]);
        }
    } else {
        ans.push_back(s[idx]);
    }
    process(s, idx + 1, ans, good);
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    string ans;
    bool good = false;
    process(s, 0, ans, good);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
